name: The Atomic Brothers
caption: Atom and Nuke's own long-running tag team, defeated by True Evil in a Texas Tornado tag match at Total Anarchy 2001 after Atom turned on his own brother earlier the same year.

tenures.source: the promotion's own broadcasts across Saturday Storm, British Brawl and Total Anarchy 2001

name: True Evil
caption: Salaok and Quartz's own tag team, briefly the WCWF Tag Team Champions of the World until Shawn and Derek Frost take the belts at British Brawl; billed once as True Fear on Wednesday Evening Confessions.

tenures.source: the promotion's own broadcasts across Wednesday Evening Confessions (billed there as True Fear), British Brawl and Total Anarchy 2001

name: Cold Steel
caption: Bobby McCann's tag pairing with Dante Reid, who lost the reinstated United States Tag Team Championship to YB2K1 at Total Anarchy 2001.

tenures.source: the promotion's own Meltdown and Total Anarchy 2001 broadcasts

name: Knights of Anarchy
caption: Raymond Chandler's own faction of knights, its ranks thinning across the promotion's own held run as The Judge and Nathaniel Duke each turned to join the Corporation.

tenures.source: the promotion's own broadcasts across all five of the held 2001 cards

name: The Corporation
caption: Dick Hart's own faction of turned former Knights, whose team lost a stable-stakes six-man tag match at Total Anarchy 2001.

tenures.source: the promotion's own Wednesday Evening Confessions, British Brawl and Total Anarchy 2001 broadcasts

identity.note: Shares its name with an existing unit record in an unrelated held wing; kept distinct under the generic-name doctrine (no shared operator, host or roster evidenced).

name: YB2K1
caption: Derek Frost and Shawn's own tag team, winning both the World Tag Team Championship at British Brawl and the reinstated United States Tag Team Championship at Total Anarchy 2001.

tenures.source: the promotion's own British Brawl and Total Anarchy 2001 broadcasts

name: LSD
caption: Stan and Floyd's own tag team, winning a Total Anarchy 2001 tag match over the Funk Soul Brothers and earning a future World Tag Team title shot.

tenures.source: the promotion's own Total Anarchy 2001 broadcast (31 Mar 2001)

name: The Funk Soul Brothers
caption: Leo and Lamar's own tag team, billed the Gemini Twins, on the losing end of a Total Anarchy 2001 tag match against LSD.

tenures.source: the promotion's own Total Anarchy 2001 broadcast (31 Mar 2001)

name: The Outlaws
caption: Thomas James and Cody Briggs's own tag team, winning a British Brawl number-one-contenders match by disqualification after Atom turned on his own partner Nuke.

tenures.source: the promotion's own Meltdown and British Brawl broadcasts

identity.note: Shares its name with 2 existing unit records in unrelated held wings; kept distinct under the generic-name doctrine (no shared operator, host or roster evidenced).

name: Final Destination
caption: Eyval and the Unibomber's own tag pairing, defeated by an ad hoc team of Raziel Lucifer and Jason Myers at Total Anarchy 2001.

tenures.source: the promotion's own Total Anarchy 2001 broadcast (31 Mar 2001)
